description: This file implements an HTTP server for serving extension files in an Electron-based desktop application. It includes functions for normalizing file paths, handling HTTP requests, error handling, and server creation.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs error messages with a specific prefix.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs informational messages with a specific prefix.

methods.name: normalizeFilePath
methods.description: Normalizes and constructs a file path based on the request URL and host, ensuring security against path traversal.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests, serving files if valid, or delegating to error handling.

methods.name: onRequestError
methods.description: Handles errors during request processing, sending appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: createExtensionsServer
methods.description: Creates and starts an HTTP server on localhost to serve extension files.
